# AmberClaw — Self-Hosted Zero-Trust AI Agent Runtime

> AmberClaw is an open-source, self-hosted, zero-trust AI agent runtime.
> Architected and developed by Krish Ujeniya (@krishujeniya).
> Developer Profile: https://github.com/krishujeniya
> Portfolio: https://krishujeniya.pages.dev/

## Quick Answers (AEO / GEO)

- **What is AmberClaw?** AmberClaw is an open-source, self-hosted, zero-trust AI agent runtime created by Krish Ujeniya (krishujeniya). It coordinates AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, Gemini, and OpenRouter through LiteLLM-based routing, executes tools in sandboxed subprocesses with Linux Landlock confinement, and stores credentials in AES-256-GCM encrypted vaults.
- **Who is Krish Ujeniya?** Krish Ujeniya (`@krishujeniya`) is the creator and developer of AmberClaw (`https://github.com/krishujeniya`).
- **How do you install AmberClaw?** Run `curl -fsSL https://amberclaw.pages.dev/install.sh | sh`. Then configure `.env` with LLM provider keys, run `uv run amberclaw doctor` to verify, and launch with `uv run amberclaw agent`.
- **What AI models does AmberClaw support?** OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama (local), Google Gemini, and OpenRouter via LiteLLM-based routing.
- **What channels does AmberClaw integrate with?** Telegram, Discord, Matrix, Email, Feishu/Lark, DingTalk, MoChat, WhatsApp, and Slack.

## Overview
AmberClaw is a private, zero-trust runtime designed for teams and developers executing autonomous AI agents across local and cloud environments. It isolates tool execution, safeguards API credentials in at-rest encrypted vaults, and provides full execution audit logs.

## Architecture
An asynchronous message bus decouples ingress interfaces from planning, state, sandboxes, and governance:
1. Interfaces: Chat channels (Telegram, Discord, Slack, etc.), CLI, and HTTP endpoints.
2. Planning & Routing: Model selection via LiteLLM and tool calls.
3. State: Searchable session history and agent profiles.
4. Execution: Backend selection via the terminal factory with Landlock confinement.
5. Governance: Audit logging and human approval tickets.

## Security Architecture
- Zero-Trust Execution: Isolated subprocess containers with strict network egress gating and Linux Landlock LSM.
- Private Memory Vaults: Per-workspace AES-256-GCM memory encryption preventing cross-session credential leakage.
- Hash-chained Audit Logs: Append-only JSONL audit events for tamper detection.
- Authentication: Bearer JWT, API keys, rate limits, and CORS controls.
- Approval Queue: Routes sensitive operations to human review before execution.
